notes.title: 34EVERLAST Playable at Tokyo Game Show 2025!
notes.content:
34EVERLAST will be shown in playable form at Tokyo Game Show 2025, being held at Makuhari Messe from 9/25 through 9/28! The game is scheduled to be playable at the PLAYISM booth (08-S03), the HYPER REAL booth (11-E19), and the SELECTED INDIE 80 (E-63) booth.
 
The demo version allows you to pick up the game's basic controls and offers a sneak preview of the gameplay experience new to this title, in which actions in one world effect another.
 
Those who try the game out will receive one illustrated sticker. The reverse-side of which has a QR code for the download of an original song.
 
Each booth has different stickers, so be sure to collect them all!

notes.title: 34EVERLAST Official Discord Community Server!
notes.content:
Dear all,
